0022600225.text: The Rockets (8-3, 5-1 at home) host the Golden State Warriors (8-3, 6-1 at home) in Houston's 12th game of the season, with the Rockets 2nd in the Southwest, 1 game back, and 5th in the West, while the Warriors are 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, and 3rd in the West. Houston is 7-3 over its last 10 games and on a one-game winning streak, with Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain) out, while Golden State, on an eight-game winning streak and 8-2 over its last 10, is missing Brandon Williams (hamstring), Gary Payton II (knee inflammation), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Houston won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 117-116 win in San Francisco on April 5, 2026.
